situation (example wording): "murder rate in 2024", "top 10 auto theft rates in 2025", "historical clearance rate for murder since 1960", "which city has the highest murder rate per 100K in 2024"
what the app does today: A question with no place asks which place (P12); the ask is the answer for questions that name no place at all.
proposed behavior: No place named is the United States, answered as the nation, with the note "No place was named, so the United States is shown." and buttons to pick a state or an agency. A ranking question with no place ranks across the nation (P128, P105 as they stand). A place the reader could not resolve (a name that is not found) still asks or declines as today (P28 for several places of one name stays; an unresolved place is not the nation). A follow-up with no place keeps the previous question's place (P69, P123 unchanged).
exact default or choices offered: Note and buttons: pick a state or an agency.
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (typed, through the coordinator): no place named = the United States, with a note saying so and buttons to pick a place, instead of "which place?". Supersedes P12 for a question with no place at all; P28 and the unresolved-place decline are unchanged.
status: Decided 2026-11-21 (Jeff, through the coordinator); built in the defaults PR
